DATA.INTRO_BEFORE: We adopt this policy in compliance with Colombian Ley 1581 de 2012, Decreto 1377 de 2013 (compiled in Decreto 1074 de 2015) and the other Colombian rules on personal data protection (habeas data). It is complemented by the
DATA.INTRO_MID: , which describes in detail the data we collect and its purposes.
DATA.NOTE: If there are differences between translations, the Spanish version prevails.
DATA.P_AREA: The privacy area of {company} handles requests, inquiries and claims at {email} and by phone at {phone}.
DATA.P_CATEGORIES:
- **Identification and contact:** email address and name received from Google, account identifier and username.
- **Contractual relationship:** matches, moves, results, tournaments, chat, balance, deposits, withdrawals, wallet addresses and transaction IDs.
- **Technical:** IP address, browser, device, app version and access, error and audit logs.
- **Verification:** identity and source-of-funds documents, when requested.
We do not process sensitive data, unless an identity check requires biometric data. In that case we will tell you that you are not obliged to provide it and ask for your explicit authorization. We do not process data of children or adolescents.
DATA.P_LEGAL_BASIS: We collect, store, use, circulate, update and delete personal data for the purposes in section 6. We do so with the prior, express and informed authorization of the data subject, which is given when creating the account or signing in, and we keep proof of it. No authorization is required in the cases of article 10 of Ley 1581 de 2012, such as a request from an authority or data of a public nature.
DATA.P_PRINCIPLES: We process data according to the principles in article 4 of Ley 1581 de 2012: legality, purpose, freedom, accuracy or quality, transparency, restricted access and circulation, security and confidentiality.
DATA.P_PROCEDURE:
**Inquiries.** To find out what data we hold or how we process it, write to {email}. We reply within ten (10) business days of receiving the inquiry. If that is not possible, we will tell you why and reply within the following five (5) business days.
**Claims.** You can file a claim to correct, update or delete data, revoke the authorization or report a breach. Send to {email} your identification, a description of the facts, your contact address or email and any documents you want to rely on. If the claim is incomplete, we will ask you to complete it within five (5) days. If two (2) months pass without you completing it, we will consider it withdrawn. Once complete, we will mark it as "claim in progress" within two (2) business days and reply within fifteen (15) business days. If that is not possible, we will tell you why and reply within the following eight (8) business days.
**Complaint to the authority.** After completing this procedure, you can go to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (www.sic.gov.co).
DATA.P_PURPOSES:
- Providing the Service: account, authentication, matches, tournaments, history and support.
- Managing the balance: deposits, withdrawals, fees, accounting and tax obligations.
- Verifying identity and age, preventing fraud, cheating and money laundering, and protecting security.
- Handling requests, inquiries and claims.
- Sending Service communications by email, in the app or through notifications.
- Measuring performance and fixing errors.
- Complying with the law, responding to authorities and exercising or defending rights.
DATA.P_RECIPIENTS: We may transmit data to processors that handle it on our behalf under confidentiality and security obligations: Microsoft Azure, MongoDB Atlas, Google, NOWPayments and Binance. We also provide data to authorities that request it in accordance with the law.
DATA.P_RETENTION: This policy is effective from October 18, 2026. The databases will remain in force while the Service is provided and for as long as needed to fulfil their purposes and the legal, accounting, tax and anti-money-laundering obligations, which can be up to ten (10) years after the last operation. We will communicate any substantial change before applying it.
DATA.P_RIGHTS:
Under article 8 of Ley 1581 de 2012, you have the right to:
- Know, update and correct your personal data.
- Request proof of the authorization given.
- Be informed, on request, about how your data has been used.
- File complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) after completing the inquiry or claim procedure with us.
- Revoke the authorization or request deletion of the data when the legal principles, rights and guarantees are not respected. Revocation and deletion do not apply when there is a legal or contractual duty to keep the data.
- Access your personal data free of charge.
These rights may be exercised by the data subject, their successors, their representative or their attorney, upon proof of that status.
DATA.P_SCOPE: This policy applies to every database containing personal data that we process to provide the Play4Cash Service. The terms data subject, controller, processor, processing, authorization, sensitive data, transmission and transfer have the meaning given to them by Ley 1581 de 2012 and Decreto 1377 de 2013.
DATA.P_SECURITY: We adopt technical, human and administrative measures to protect data against tampering, loss and unauthorized or fraudulent consultation, use or access. We will report to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) any security incidents that require it.
DATA.P_TRANSFERS: Some processors are outside Colombia, for example in the United States or the European Union. By accepting this policy, the data subject expressly authorizes that international transmission or transfer, in accordance with article 26 of Ley 1581 de 2012 and articles 24 and 25 of Decreto 1377 de 2013.
DATA.TITLE: Personal Data Processing Policy

PRIVACY.INTRO_BEFORE: This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use Play4Cash, what we use it for, who we share it with and how you can exercise your rights. It is complemented by the
PRIVACY.NOTE: Version in force since October 18, 2026. If there are differences between translations, the Spanish version prevails.
PRIVACY.P_AUTHORIZATION: By creating your account or signing in, you give us prior, express and informed authorization to process your data for the purposes in this policy. That authorization includes its transmission and transfer to the providers and countries listed below. We keep proof of the authorization. The law allows some processing without authorization, for example to respond to a request from an authority.
PRIVACY.P_CHANGES: We may update this policy and will publish each new version with its date. If the changes are significant or alter the purposes, we will notify you and, where the law requires it, ask for your authorization again.
PRIVACY.P_CONTROLLER: **{company}**, NIT {nit}, domiciled at {address}. Email for privacy matters: {email}. Phone: {phone}.
PRIVACY.P_COOKIES: We use strictly necessary technical cookies to keep you securely signed in. We also use your browser's local storage to save preferences, such as language, and the state of ongoing matches. We do not use advertising cookies. Google may use its own cookies when you sign in with your account. If you block these cookies, you may not be able to sign in or play.
PRIVACY.P_DATA:
- **Account:** the email address and name that Google gives us when you sign in, your username and your language.
- **Gameplay:** rooms, matches, moves, results, tournaments, statistics and chat messages.
- **Financial:** balance, deposits, withdrawals, the withdrawal wallet you register (address, network and currency), blockchain transaction IDs, amounts and fees. We do not receive payment cards or your wallet keys.
- **Technical and security:** IP address, browser and device type, app version, error, access and audit logs, and your notification subscription if you turn notifications on.
- **Verification:** identity and source-of-funds documents, if we ask for them.
- **Communications:** the messages you send to support or by email.
We do not ask for sensitive data, such as health data, racial origin, political opinions or biometric data. If an identity check ever required any, for example a photo of your face, we will tell you that providing it is optional and ask for your explicit authorization.
PRIVACY.P_MINORS: The Service is only for people aged 18 or older, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we detect a minor's account, we will close it, refund the deposited balance where possible and delete their data, except data the law requires us to keep.
PRIVACY.P_PURPOSES:
- Creating and managing your account and authenticating you.
- Organizing matches and tournaments, applying the rules, determining results and showing your history.
- Processing deposits, withdrawals and fees, and keeping the accounts.
- Verifying your identity and age, preventing fraud, cheating, multi-accounting and money laundering, and protecting the security of the Service.
- Handling support, requests, complaints and claims.
- Sending you Service notices, such as verification codes, changes to these documents and the notifications you turn on.
- Measuring performance and fixing app errors.
- Meeting legal, accounting and tax obligations, responding to authorities and defending our rights.
We do not sell your personal data or use it for third-party advertising. If we ever want to send you our own advertising, we will ask for your authorization, and you can withdraw it at any time.
PRIVACY.P_RETENTION: We keep your data while your account is active. After closure, we keep records of transactions, matches with balance at stake and verification for as long as accounting, tax and anti-money-laundering rules require, which can be up to ten (10) years. Technical and security logs are kept as long as they are needed for security or to handle claims. After those periods, we delete or anonymize the data.
PRIVACY.P_RIGHTS: As the data subject, you have the right to know, update and correct your data and to access it free of charge. You can also request proof of your authorization, find out how we use your data, revoke the authorization or request deletion when there is no legal or contractual duty to keep the data, and file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) after submitting your inquiry or claim to us. Write to us at {email}. Deadlines and procedure are set out in the Personal Data Processing Policy.
PRIVACY.P_SECURITY: We apply reasonable technical, human and administrative measures, such as encrypted connections, access control, two-factor authentication for sensitive administrative operations, audit logs and separation of duties. No system is infallible. If an incident affects your data, we will report it to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) and to those affected where required.
PRIVACY.P_SHARING:
We only share the data that is necessary, and only with:
- **Providers that process data on our behalf:** cloud hosting and infrastructure (Microsoft Azure), database (MongoDB Atlas), sign-in and email delivery (Google), cryptocurrency payment processing (NOWPayments) and exchange and custody services (Binance).
- **Other players:** your username, moves, results and chat messages are shown to the people in your matches and tournaments.
- **Authorities:** when required by law, a court order or a valid request.
- **A successor:** if operation of the Service passes to another company, which must respect this policy.
PRIVACY.P_TRANSFERS: Several of our providers have servers outside Colombia, for example in the United States or the European Union. By accepting this policy, you authorize your data to be transmitted or transferred to those countries. We require those providers to apply adequate security and confidentiality measures and to use the data only to provide their services to us.
PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
